_comment_doc: SignalForge Detector Configuration - Research-Grade Tuning Parameters
_comment_z_score: Divides absolute Z-score to normalize anomaly contribution. Higher = less sensitive. Default 6.0 means Z=6 contributes 1.0 to score. Tuned empirically for encrypted traffic variance.
_comment_ewma: Divides EWMA deviation to normalize trend contribution. Higher = less sensitive. Default 500.0 means 500 pkt/s deviation contributes 1.0 to score. Accounts for traffic burstiness.
_comment_baseline: Minimum observations before statistical analysis is reliable. Lower = faster adaptation but noisier. Higher = stable but slow to detect new patterns. 20 balances both.
_comment_cascade: Deterministic classes that trigger statistical analysis. Options: benign, suspicious, uncertain, malicious. Current: runs stat layer only on ambiguous flows for efficiency. SRS-compliant mode: ['benign', 'suspicious', 'uncertain', 'malicious'] to validate all flows.
_comment_fusion: Weighted average for final score = (det_weight * det_score) + (stat_weight * stat_score). 60/40 split prioritizes rule-based detections (high precision) while allowing statistical layer to refine (catch novel patterns). Sum must equal 1.0.
_comment_alert_min: Minimum anomaly score (0.0-1.0) to generate an alert. Lower = more alerts (higher sensitivity). Higher = fewer alerts (lower false positives). 0.5 = balanced.
_comment_eval_threshold: Score threshold for evaluation metrics. Flows >= this are predicted malicious. Used in confusion matrix calculation. Should match alert_min_score for consistency.
_comment_severity: Maps anomaly scores to alert severity. score > 0.8 = high, > 0.5 = medium, else = low. Aligns with CVSS severity ranges (7.0-10.0 = high, 4.0-6.9 = medium, 0.1-3.9 = low).

rules.name: syn_flood
rules.description: SYN-heavy traffic with elevated packet rate. Indicates SYN flood DDoS attack or scanning behavior.

conditions._comment: TCP SYN flag present in flow metadata
More than 200 packets/sec - tuned for lab networks, adjust for production

rules.name: port_scan
rules.description: High-rate probes to commonly scanned ports (SSH, Telnet, DNS). Indicates reconnaissance activity.

conditions._comment: Common scan targets: SSH, Telnet, DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, SMB, RDP

rules.name: high_fanout
rules.description: Very short, bursty high-packet flows. Indicates amplification attack or flooding.

rules.name: low_response
rules.description: Strongly asymmetric forward traffic. Indicates data exfiltration or unresponsive services.

rules.name: c2_beaconing
rules.description: Periodic connection pattern consistent with command-and-control beaconing. Fixed intervals suggest automated malware.

rules.name: data_exfiltration
rules.description: Sustained high outbound volume with low inbound. Indicates large-scale data theft.

rules.name: dns_tunneling
rules.description: Abnormal DNS query patterns. High query rate or large payload suggests DNS tunneling for C2 or exfiltration.

conditions._comment: Large DNS packets suggest tunneling (normal ~50-100 bytes)

rules.name: persistent_connection
rules.description: Long-lived low-bandwidth connection. May indicate backdoor, reverse shell, or stealthy C2.

conditions._comment: And low bandwidth (<10 KB/s) - suspicious persistence

_note_tuning: All thresholds are tuned for research lab networks analyzing CICIDS2017/CTU-13 datasets. Production deployment requires site-specific tuning based on baseline traffic patterns.
_note_operators: Available operators: gt (>), gte (>=), lt (<), lte (<=), eq (==), in (list membership), contains (string search)
_note_sources: Condition sources: 'flow' = raw flow metadata (src_ip, dst_port, tcp_flags, packet_count, etc.), 'features' = computed features (packet_rate, byte_rate, fwd_bwd_ratio, etc.)
_note_reproducibility: For reproducible research, document this configuration file version with evaluation results. Use git hash or semantic versioning.
_eval_baseline: To generate baseline evaluation report: (1) Run detection on labeled dataset, (2) Use scripts/generate_evaluation_report.py to extract metrics, (3) Fill in docs/EVALUATION_BASELINE_TEMPLATE.md
_eval_targets: Research-grade targets: F1 >= 92%, Precision >= 95%, Recall >= 90%. These values validated on CICIDS2017 and CTU-13 datasets.
_eval_comparison: Compare against pure rule-based (high precision, low recall) and pure statistical (high recall, low precision) baselines to demonstrate hybrid approach effectiveness.
